title: Selvage Session Protocol — error codes and close codes
description: The machine-readable vocabulary of faults: `error.code` on a response, `session.error.params.code` on an event, and the WebSocket close code that a fatal fault is paired with. Valid against PROTOCOL.md §11.

errorCode.description: Every code this protocol defines. A code a receiver does not know is treated as an unknown fault, not as a protocol error.

extensionCode.description: An implementation's own code in the reserved `x.` namespace (PROTOCOL.md §10.1, §11): only the `x.` prefix is protocol, the suffix is the definer's. The reference server refuses past its capacity with `x.server_full`, `x.room_full` and `x.rate_limited`, the bounds and their close codes in PROTOCOL.md §2.1. Not defined by this protocol, but carriable wherever an `errorCode` is.

closeCode.description: WebSocket close codes, in the private-use range: 4000 protocol_error, 4001 room_unknown, 4002 token_invalid, 4003 room_gone.

errorObject.description: `error` on a response (§4.2) and `params` on a `session.error` event (§6) are the same shape. `message` is human-readable and explicitly not stable, so nothing may depend on it.
